verdict.rationale: Formant documents a query API, reached through the Python Cloud SDK, as the primary programmatic way to query telemetry data, on a page titled data export. It also supports custom SQL queries in Analytics. The SQL support is documented only for building dashboards, and the export workflow itself (formats, bulk extraction, offline handoff) is not detailed. missing for 10: documented export formats or a bulk-download mechanism, evidence that SQL can be used for raw data extraction beyond dashboards, a published API reference (OpenAPI probe returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can query and export collected robot data through an API or SQL for offline analysis

citations.quote: The primary programmatic way data scientists query for telemetry data is via the Cloud SDK, a lightweight Python module which can interact with the query API.
Using built-in visualizations, custom SQL queries, or our AI assistant, you can build a rich dashboard for your devices.
You can analyze from an individual device, or from a fleet of devices by device group or tag.
